method: 20 cold and 20 warm pages; 50 distinct authored PNG posters (300x450, average 291016 bytes); six parallel httptest handler workers; loopback httptest upstream; explicit Android format=jpeg; cold clears raw and converted caches each page; warm prefetches once; CPU is RUSAGE_SELF user+system divided by 1000 images; p95 is 19th of 20 sorted complete-page wall times. Setup/image generation/compilation excluded.
limitations: Shared Mac with unrelated workloads and measured paging; sequential before/after samples, not randomized. No physical Android or public-network timing. No cold speedup claimed.
